name: participle-stateful-lexer
instr:
I'm restoring participle's stateful lexer (`github.com/alecthomas/participle/v2`), the default lexer nearly every grammar in the project leans on. The lexer, the token-mapping options, the parse errors and the parser entry points that sit on top of it are only signatures with `panic("not implemented")` bodies, so almost nothing can lex or parse. Could you fill them back in?

The stubs are in the root package (`error.go`, `map.go`, `nodes.go`, `options.go`, `parser.go`) and in `lexer` (`api.go`, `errors.go`, `stateful.go`, `text_scanner.go`). They cover the stateful lexer (`New`, `MustStateful`, `Push`, `Pop`, `Include`, `Return`, `Symbols`, `Lex`/`LexString`, `Next` and the `Rule` JSON encoding), `NewTextScannerLexer`, `Must`, `ConsumeAll` and the lexer's `Error`; and, in the root package, the `Lexer`, `CaseInsensitive`, `Map`, `Unquote`, `Upper` and `Elide` options with the mapping lexer behind them, `ParseError` and its accessors, wrapped-error unwrapping, parsing of `Parseable` grammar nodes, `Parser.Lex`, `Parser.Parse` and `ParserForProduction`.

The doc comments on those functions are the contract; `lexer/doc.go` and `README.md` explain states, Push/Pop/Include, backreferences and elided tokens.

I'll run the main module's tests afterwards (`go test ./...` from the repo root; the separate `_examples` and `cmd/participle` modules aren't part of it), so the rest of them have to keep passing (except `TestLexerConformanceGenerated`, which builds `cmd/participle` and can't r
